titleEn: Royal decrees No. 0819/1301 on the establishment of Tboung Khmum Appeal Court

articles.en:
The Tboung Khmum Regional Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor's Office attached to the Tboung Khmum Regional Court of Appeal shall be located in Tboung Khmum Province.
[Illegible in source]

The Tboung Khmum Regional Court of Appeal and the General Prosecutor's Office attached to the Tboung Khmum Regional Court of Appeal shall receive and decide appeals against the decisions of the First Instance Court of Kampong Cham and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Kampong Thom and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Preah Vihear and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Kratie and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Stung Treng and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Ratanakiri and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Mondulkiri and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Prey Veng and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, the First Instance Court of Svay Rieng and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, and the First Instance Court of Tboung Khmum and the Prosecutor's Office attached thereto, or cases remitted by the Supreme Court.
Any provisions contrary to this Royal Decree shall be considered null and void.

The Supreme Council of the Magistracy and Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia, shall be responsible for implementing this Royal Decree from the date of signature onwards.
Norodom Sihamoni; at the Royal Palace, 07 August 2019; certified true copy of the original.
Minister in charge of the Council of Ministers, Kitti Nitikosol Bandit Bin Chhin.
